name: smwmusic-metroid-ii-return-of-samus-march-of-the-bounty-hunter-surface-of-sr388-remix
title: Metroid II: Return of Samus - March of the Bounty Hunter ~ Surface of SR388 (Remix)
description:
𝗜 𝗻𝗲𝘅𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗠𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗶𝗱𝘀 𝗼𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗶𝗿 𝗵𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱, 𝗦𝗥𝟯𝟴𝟴. 𝗜 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗹𝘆 𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗺 𝗲𝘅𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗮 𝗹𝗮𝗿𝘃𝗮, 𝘄𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗵 𝗮𝗳𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗵𝗮𝘁𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗱 𝗺𝗲 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗮 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗳𝘂𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗱...

Did a remix of the heroic and upbeat Surface of SR388. Had loads of fun doing this one. It's one of my favorite songs in the entire series. Guess the Metroid series has really grown on me. :)

This baby is great for caverns, factories, underwater stages, and space stages.

Important:
There is a "!READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.
